nodes.name: Run an Actor and get dataset

parameters.content:
## Social Fetch - X (Apify)
Gets the newest original posts (no retweets, replies or quotes) of an X (Twitter) account: likes, replies, reposts + quotes. Views come from the actor's `viewCount` (can be N/A on some tweets).

### What to change
1. **Run an Actor and get dataset** -> select your **Apify API** credential (same one as TikTok).
2. **Test accounts** -> your X handles without @ (e.g. `brandA`). Only used by *Test manually*; the real handles live in the main **Accounts config** (`platform: 'X'`, `account_id` = handle, `enabled: true`).
3. Click **Test manually** and check the Normalize X rows output.

### Get the token
Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations > copy the API token -> n8n credential **Apify API**. No expiry unless revoked.
Actor: `kaitoeasyapi/twitter-x-data-tweet-scraper-pay-per-result-cheapest` (about $0.2 per 1,000 tweets, minimum 20 per run; the workflow keeps the newest 10 per account). It returns ~20 tweets per query, so a very busy account may miss older posts. When it finds nothing it can return fake `mock_tweet` rows: Normalize X rows ignores them.
The search text `from:<handle> -filter:replies -filter:quote -filter:nativeretweets` asks X itself to skip replies, quotes and retweets (X search syntax; if the actor ignores it, Normalize X rows still drops them).
Status: new, not yet tested on real data.
